card.name: Age words before a number range
card.fires_on: The word for age (age, Ages, aged) right before a number range in pediatric or children's age descriptions. It also fires inside a few brand and drug names such as RYBREVANT, levocarnitine and Lipiodol.

modes.label: Age before a number
modes.description: Words like age, Ages or aged that introduce an age range or limit.

modes.label: Inside brand or drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand or drug name, such as the Y in RYBREVANT.
modes.example: Remove the appropriate number of R<<Y>>BREVANT FASPRO vial

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model to write a digit or number-related piece such as 'th', 'ths' or 'mal' next.
card.plain: It lights up when the text says 'aged' or 'ages' just before an age range, and also on some brand-name pieces.
